declarations.name: Cholesky.FloatingPoint.mk
declarations.type:
{u : Real} →
  (round : Real → Real) →
    (InRange : Real → Prop) →
      (∀ (x : Real),
          InRange x →
            ∃ δ, And (LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} δ) u) (Eq.{1} (round x) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} x (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 δ)))) →
        Cholesky.FloatingPoint u

declarations.name: Cholesky.NoOverflowUnderflow
declarations.type:
{n : Nat} →
  {u : Real} →
    Cholesky.FloatingPoint u → Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real → Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real → Prop

declarations.name: Cholesky.NoOverflowUnderflow.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} {u : Real} {fp : Cholesky.FloatingPoint u} {A R : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real},
  (∀ (i j : Fin n), LE.le.{0} i j → Cholesky.dotInRange fp (Cholesky.prefixPairs R i j)) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin n),
        LE.le.{0} i j →
          Ne.{1} (↑i) 0 →
            Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp
              (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (A i j) (Cholesky.roundedDot fp (Cholesky.prefixPairs R i j)))) →
      (∀ (i j : Fin n),
          LT.lt.{0} i j →
            Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.updateNumerator fp A R i j) (R i i))) →
        (∀ (j : Fin n), Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp (Real.sqrt (Cholesky.updateNumerator fp A R j j))) →
          Cholesky.NoOverflowUnderflow fp A R

declarations.name: Cholesky.SuccessfulRun
declarations.type:
{n : Nat} →
  {u : Real} →
    Cholesky.FloatingPoint u → Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real → Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real → Prop

declarations.name: Cholesky.SuccessfulRun.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} {u : Real} {fp : Cholesky.FloatingPoint u} {A R : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real},
  (∀ (i j : Fin n), LT.lt.{0} j i → Eq.{1} (R i j) 0) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), LE.le.{0} 0 (Cholesky.updateNumerator fp A R j j)) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n),
          Eq.{1} (R j j) (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp (Real.sqrt (Cholesky.updateNumerator fp A R j j)))) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin n), LT.lt.{0} i j → Ne.{1} (R i i) 0) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin n),
              LT.lt.{0} i j →
                Eq.{1} (R i j)
                  (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp
                    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.updateNumerator fp A R i j) (R i i)))) →
            Cholesky.SuccessfulRun fp A R

declarations.name: Cholesky.cholesky_factorization
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} (A R : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (u : Real) (fp : Cholesky.FloatingPoint u),
  Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} A →
    Matrix.PosDef.{0, 0} A →
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)) u) 1 →
          Cholesky.SuccessfulRun fp A R →
            Cholesky.NoOverflowUnderflow fp A R →
              ∃ ΔA,
                And (Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} ΔA)
                  (And (Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R) R) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA))
                    (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                      LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.gamma (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1) u)
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.entryAbs (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R)) (Cholesky.entryAbs R)
                            i j))))

declarations.body:
fun {u} fp x =>
  match x with
  | List.nil.{0} => True
  | List.cons.{0} p ps =>
    And (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2))
      (Cholesky.dotTailInRange fp (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2)) ps)
declarations.name: Cholesky.dotInRange
declarations.type: {u : Real} → Cholesky.FloatingPoint u → List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Real Real) → Prop

declarations.body:
fun {u} fp s x =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x
    (fun x f s =>
      (match (motive :=
          (x : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Real Real)) → List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x → Real) x with
        | List.nil.{0} => fun x => s
        | List.cons.{0} p ps => fun x =>
          x.1
            (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2)))))
        f)
    s

declarations.body:
fun {u} fp s x =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Prop) x
    (fun x f s =>
      (match (motive :=
          (x : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Real Real)) → List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Prop) x → Prop) x with
        | List.nil.{0} => fun x => True
        | List.cons.{0} p ps => fun x =>
          And (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2))
            (And
              (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.InRange fp
                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2))))
              (x.1
                (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s (Cholesky.FloatingPoint.round fp (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2)))))))
        f)
    s
